Documents to bring to avail a vehicle sticker
Can someone else pick up my vehicle sticker on my behalf?

Yes, an authorized representative may claim your sticker at Gate 1 (Window 2) provided they present a signed Authorization Letter, a photocopy of your UE Student ID, their own valid government ID, and your original OR/CR.
How long is the vehicle sticker valid?
The UE Campus Pass vehicle sticker is valid for one (1) full academic year, covering both the 1st and 2nd semesters (including the summer term) until the next renewal period.
What if I buy a new car or change vehicle plates?
Submit a new vehicle application with your updated OR/CR and vehicle photo, then surrender your previously issued sticker at Gate 1 (Window 2) to claim your replacement pass.
Where should the vehicle sticker be installed on my vehicle
For 4-wheel vehicles, affix the sticker inside the upper-right corner of the front windshield. For motorcycles, attach it visibly on the front fork or windshield visor for quick Gate 1 inspection.
